goal.raw_text: Allow the user to view detailed information and inspectional knowledge about selected files or archives, including their properties and the results of test/check operations.

claims.content: User
The user must have selected at least one file or archive object in the file manager interface.
The Test/Check feature must be available and applicable to the selected object type.
The user selects the Test/Check feature for a selected file or archive object.

trigger.raw_text: The user selects the Test/Check feature for a selected file or archive object.

claims.content: The user selects the Test/Check feature for a selected file or archive object in the file manager interface.
The system displays information about the object (file or archive) and the progress of the test/check operation in the PeaLauncher window.
The PeaLauncher window provides a graphic display of the currently executed function's progress, including input/output sizes, time taken, and status tabs (Status, Report, Console).
Upon completion, the user can view the results of the test/check operation directly in the PeaLauncher window.

If errors occur during the Test/Check operation, the PeaLauncher window remains open to display error information, as indicated by the setting 'Keep open only if needed (errors, list, test...)' in the Settings Interface.
The PeaLauncher window displays the completion status of the Test/Check operation, including input size, output size, compression ratio, and execution time.
Upon successful completion, the user can view the test/check results directly within the PeaLauncher window via Status, Report, or Console tabs.
If configured in Settings, the PeaLauncher window may remain open after completion only if errors occurred or if explicitly set to stay open for test operations.
